subject: Burnout 3 Day!
author: Xandu
body:
Yes, there will be a Burnout 3 Takedown weekly Wednesday today. I will be hosting a room (look for the BurnoutAholics.com room). Others might need to host as well if more than 6 people turn up. I will probably be online from around 7PM GMT.

-- The Creator --

subject: Oh Yes!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Xandu has been busy unlocking all the tracks so he will be our gracious host, and last night I got to 150 takedowns so I have unlocked my lovely Assassin Super, so we are good to go!

We will be hosting a BurnoutAholics room from about 7pm today (GMT) hope to see you there! 🙂

subject: Invites will be sent
author: ZombieTron
body: Don't worry BigChelski, I will ping you an invite! 🙂

subject: Lobby
author: Xandu
body:
I'll probably use "A. US Central" since that is the first one on the list 😃. But if you select "Custom match" ( the one that show all games from all lobbies)  from the menu all games available will be shown so the choice of lobby is really not that important.

-- The Creator --

subject: Paradise every day of the week
author: Xandu
body:
The reason why we are doing a spesific day for Burnout 3 Takedown is that there is not many people playing the game online anymore. So to make sure there are people to race with we set spesific dates where we play this game.
